title: fix(spec): grade action.onSuccess.navigate/openIn and translation.flows.screens live
body:
Fixes #20296
Clause-②: no

Three liveness rows were graded `planned`, but objectui reads all three at the `.objectui-sha` pin this repo builds against (`f8a9d0fb`). This PR grades them `live`. Each row cites its mounted reader by file and symbol, with no line numbers, and names its producer leg. Each row's note says why it was `planned` and what flipped it.

Following the seat ruling on the card (comment 5860372033, answer **B**), the PR also corrects every sentence these flips made false. The `flows` container keeps its `authorWarn`, and its `authorHint` now tells the truth. Four prose sites are restated. ⛔ No schema, parse, `.describe()` or accept-set change. The three `packages/spec/src/**` edits are comments only, and a comment-stripped transpile proves it (below).

Files:
- `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`: the two `onSuccess` rows.
- `packages/spec/liveness/translation.json`: the `flows.screens` row, plus the `flows` container's `authorHint` and a dated sentence appended to its `note`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`: the translation Notes cell.
- `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts.md`: regenerated.
- JSDoc and docblock comments in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` and `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`.
- `.changeset/20296-understated-planned-rows.md`.

## Row → reader, at objectui `@f8a9d0fb`

| row | mounted reader (file · symbol) | what it reads | producer leg | control at objectui main `256b4c9e` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `action.onSuccess.navigate` | `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` · `handlePostExecution` → `readOnSuccessNavigation` → `navigateOnSuccess`; `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` · `useConsoleActionRuntime` (its `navigateHandler`) | `block.navigate`, interpolated with `${param.*}` / `${ctx.*}` / `${result.*}`, with the scheme guarded, then handed to the host's `navigationHandler` (a react-router `navigate` in the console) | the forward `onSuccess: schema.onSuccess` in `ActionButtonRenderer`, `ActionIconRenderer`, `ActionMenuRenderer` and `ActionGroupRenderer`, and `DeclaredActionButton`'s spread of the declared action | same reads |
| `action.onSuccess.openIn` | `ActionRunner.ts` · `navigateOnSuccess`; `useConsoleActionRuntime` (`navigateHandler`) | `block.openIn === 'newTab'` becomes `newTab`, with no `?? 'self'` of its own | the spec's `ActionSchema` materializes `.default('self')`; the same renderer forward | same reads |
| `translation.flows.screens` | local `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` · `resolveFlowScreenTitle`; objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` · `localizeScreen`, `activeFlowsBundle` and `FlowRunner` | the heading through `resolveFlowScreenTitle`, and each field's `label` / `placeholder` from `bundle[language]?.flows?.[flowName]?.screens?.[screen.nodeId]?.fields` over `FLOW_SCREEN_FIELD_COPY_KEYS` | this repo: `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` · `loadTranslations` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` · `handleI18nRequest` serve the bundle whole. objectui: `apps/console/src/loadLanguage.ts` · `loadLanguage` → `packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts` · `transformSpecTranslations` (forwards `flows` verbatim under `app`) → `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx` · `I18nProvider` (`addResourceBundle` into `translation`) | same reads |

**The per-read control.** Each cited string was counted with `git show REF:PATH | grep -cF` at the pin and at objectui main. All 15 reads gave the same count at both: `readOnSuccessNavigation(action.onSuccess)` 1/1, `private navigateOnSuccess(` 1/1, `block.navigate` 2/2, `block.openIn === 'newTab'` 1/1, `onSuccess: schema.onSuccess` 1/1, consoleServerAction's `readOnSuccessNavigation(action.onSuccess)` 1/1, `resolveFlowScreenTitle(bundle, flowName, screen` 1/1, `?.screens?.[screen.nodeId]?.fields` 1/1, `function activeFlowsBundle` 1/1, `FlowRunner` in `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` 1/1, `useConsoleActionRuntime({ dataSource })` in `ConsoleShell.tsx` 1/1, `ConsoleShell` in `apps/console/src/App.tsx` 1/1, `'flows',` in `spec-translations.ts` 1/1, `transformSpecTranslations(translations)` 1/1, and `r.setNavigationHandler(onNavigate)` 1/1. The ledger cites the historical form, "the `.objectui-sha` pin f8a9d0fb".

## Mount chains, closed by hand at the pin

A reader inside a component that nothing mounts is not evidence. So each chain was walked down from the console root.

- **The `onSuccess` pair.**
  - `apps/console/src/App.tsx` renders `ConsoleShell`.
  - `ConsoleShell` calls `useConsoleActionRuntime({ dataSource })` and mounts `ActionProvider` with `onNavigate={navigateHandler}` and `handlers` = `api`, `flow` and `script`.
  - `@object-ui/react`'s `ActionContext` builds the `ActionRunner` and calls `setNavigationHandler(onNavigate)`.
  - A declared action can be rendered by `action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:menu` or `action:group`; ObjectView's list toolbar renders `action:bar`. It can also be rendered by `DeclaredActionsBar`. Each of these calls `execute` with `onSuccess` still on the def.
  - `ActionRunner.execute` dispatches to the registered `api` or `script` handler, then to `handlePostExecution`. That call follows both the custom-handler path and the built-in path. It then runs `readOnSuccessNavigation` and `navigateOnSuccess`.
  - For a `script` action, `consoleServerAction.ts` sees the declared block and only closes the pre-opened tab, so one success makes one navigation. The spec already refuses `onSuccess` together with `opensInNewTab: true`.
- **`flows.screens`.**
  - `FlowRunner` is mounted in three places: in `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s dialogs (rendered by `ConsoleShell` and by the runtimes that ObjectView and DeclaredActionsBar run), in `RecordDetailView`, and on the console route `developer/flow-runs` (`FlowRunsPage`).
  - When a `type: 'flow'` action's run pauses at a screen node, the host sets `{ flowName, runId, screen }`.
  - `FlowRunner` computes `shown = localizeScreen(...)`, draws `shown.title`, and hands `shown` to `ScreenView`.
  - The bundle comes from `I18nProvider loadLanguage={loadLanguage}` in `apps/console/src/main.tsx`.
- **Server leg, in this repo.** `AppPlugin.loadTranslations` hands each bundle's locale data to the i18n service whole. The file adapter deep-merges it with no group filter. Both translations routes answer `getTranslations(locale)` whole.

## The `flows` container: `authorWarn` kept, `authorHint` made true (seat ruling B)

None of the three rows carries an `authorWarn`. The one involved sits on the `flows` container. That container also covers `flows.label`, which nothing reads yet (#20318). The bit has two readers:
- `@objectstack/lint`'s warn map;
- the CLI i18n coverage gate `authorWarnedTranslationGroups` in `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, which holds back the whole `flows.*` demand while the bit is set.

So the bit stays. When #20318 lands the label reader, the group becomes wholly live, the bit drops, and the CLI demand comes back by design. Only the hint text changes.

```text
- No shipped screen-flow runner reads this group yet — until the objectui half of #7646 lands, a `type: 'screen'` flow
  renders the strings authored on the flow (`config.title`, `fields[].label`, `fields[].placeholder`) in every locale.
+ Only part of this group is read. The console's screen-flow runner reads `screens`: each screen's `title` and each
  field's `label` / `placeholder` render in the active locale. The flow's own `label` is read by nothing yet, so a
  translated flow label is stored and never shown, and the flow keeps the label authored on it in every locale.
```

The new hint carries no tracker number, because it is text an author reads. #20318 is cited in the container `note` instead, in a dated sentence appended to it. Measured with the built lint at the head: a `zh-CN` bundle authoring `flows.lead_conversion.screens.s1.title` still draws exactly one finding. Its rule is `liveness-planned-property`, its message is unchanged ("sets `flows` but this translation property is planned — …"), and its `hint` is the new text above. `authorWarnedProperties('translation')` is still `["flows"]`. An action authoring `onSuccess` draws 0 findings, before and after.

## Prose restated (comments and ledger text only)

- `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, the translation Notes cell. The seeding sentence now reads "`flows` was the one that was not, and was `planned` at seeding". A dated **#20296** entry is appended: `flows.screens` is `live` and read by FlowRunner; `flows.label` stays `planned` (#20318), and so does the container's `authorWarn`, whose hint names the read and unread halves.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, the `onSuccess` JSDoc. "The console consumer is not wired yet … at `planned` strength" becomes a paragraph that names `ActionRunner` (`handlePostExecution` → `readOnSuccessNavigation` → `navigateOnSuccess`) at the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb`. It describes the interpolation scopes, the router handoff and `openIn: 'newTab'`, and says the ledger rows are `live`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, the `flows` JSDoc. "no shipped runner reads it yet" becomes: `FlowRunner` reads `screens` (each screen's `title`, and each field's `label` and `placeholder`); the flow's own `label` is read by nothing yet; `screens` is `live` and `label` stays `planned`.
- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, the `translateFlow` docblock. "while its liveness rows are `planned`" becomes: the #11287 runner card took the client side, and `FlowRunner` overlays `flows.FLOW.screens`. This function stays unregistered because the server-side route is not the one taken. `flows.FLOW.label` has no reader yet.
- In `translation.json`, the `flows.screens` row's closing sentence now matches the ruling (the bit drops when #20318 lands).

**Comment-only, proven.** Each of the three `src` files was transpiled with `typescript` 6.0.3 `transpileModule` (`removeComments: true`, ES2022 / ESNext) at the merge base `4e8d48d9` and at the head `080df02a`. At `4e8d48d9` these three files equal `origin/main` `10ea9eb2` (`git diff --quiet` exit 0). The output hashes (sha256, first 16 hex characters):

| file | raw base → head | stripped base | stripped head | control (a one-token code mutation of head) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `ui/action.zod.ts` | `b2e1bac7…` → `507f9472…` (differ) | `458e751a64bf8ce4` | `458e751a64bf8ce4` IDENTICAL | `'self'`→`'selg'` gives `b56bf8b4…`, which the instrument sees |
| `system/translation.zod.ts` | `9a0c42ff…` → `fdf2c86e…` (differ) | `a9fe3aa64c3a71e2` | `a9fe3aa64c3a71e2` IDENTICAL | an inserted `const` gives `6844d95c…`, which it sees |
| `system/i18n-resolver.ts` | `237136a3…` → `0b3352a5…` (differ) | `5680cc3e05cebe9a` | `5680cc3e05cebe9a` IDENTICAL | an inserted `const` gives `3029a546…`, which it sees |

## Pins, and whether they moved

They did not move. Readings at `080df02a`:
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/lint-liveness-properties.test.ts src/component-field-specs-liveness.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 91 passed (91)`, the same count as round one. This includes `authorWarnedProperties('translation').has('flows')` === true.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/i18n-flow-liveness-gate.test.ts test/i18n-flow-screen-coverage.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests 29 passed (29)`, the same count. This includes the real-ledger equality `authorWarnedTranslationGroups()` == `['flows']` and the gated `flows.*` demand.

## Verification (every reading at HEAD `080df02a`, after merging `origin/main` `10ea9eb2`)

The merge ran through `bash scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` as merge commit `4e8d48d9`. `state-counts.md` was kept on the branch side and then re-verified by the gate. The spec, lint, platform-objects and objectql closures were rebuilt with `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/platform-objects --filter=@objectstack/objectql --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (15 tasks successful).

- **`check:liveness`**: exit 0. `action 49 classified (live 46, dead 3)`, `translation 24 classified (live 23, planned 1)`, and `✓ packages/spec/liveness/state-counts.md is current`. Evidence paths: 617 local, all resolved; 223 foreign. Symbol anchors: 764 of 764. Container coverage: 109 / 564. At base `4e0f72e8` it read action 44 live / 2 planned and translation 22 / 2.
- **`check:objectui-pin-citations`**: exit 0, `47 asserting objectui pin citation(s) match .objectui-sha (f8a9d0fb0), 53 historical`. Round one read 50 historical; the three new ones are the `.objectui-sha` pin `f8a9d0fb` sentences above, in the historical form. Sources: 1653.
- **Spec package.** `--project local`: exit 0, `Test Files 553 passed (553)`, `Tests 16326 passed | 1 todo`. `--project repo`: exit 0, `Test Files 33 passed (33)`, `Tests 604 passed (604)`. The repo project includes the docblock pins that read `action.zod.ts` as text, such as `action-requires-confirmation-docblock.pin.test.ts`.
- **Spec typecheck.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Other suites that read the edited files as text.** `@objectstack/platform-objects` `src/apps/translations/action-body-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`: exit 0, 22 passed. `@objectstack/sdui-parser` `src/__tests__/dashboard-widget-options.test.ts`: exit 0, 21 passed.
- **Derived gate families.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, derived from the 8 actual changed paths at `080df02a`, gave 83 commands, identical to the derivation at `f6e3558d`. 81 exited 0. Reconciled: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 83 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 81 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. `check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:authorable-surface` and `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` each exited 0.
- **Roster gates whose roster lives in a changed directory** (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`): each exit 0.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It needs every publishable package built. This is a declared narrowing; CI builds the workspace and runs it.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:i18n-walk-parity`.** Exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. It needs `@objectstack/cli` built, a closure of about 45 packages. It is derived here only because `i18n-resolver.ts` changed, and that change is comment-only: the stripped transpile above is identical. This is a declared narrowing; CI builds and runs it.
- **ESLint, narrowed and proven.** The config's population is `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']`, and 3 of the 8 changed paths are in it: the three `src` files. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over all 8 paths gives exit 0, 8 files, 0 errors and 5 warnings. The 3 `src` files have 0 errors and 0 warnings. Each of the 5 warnings is `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied`, on the JSON, markdown and changeset paths. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- Two more sentences are made false by these flips. Both sit outside the seat's bounded list, so they are left for the seat. They are routed in the dispatch report:
  - `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`, the `action` `onSuccess` omit entry. Its `why` reads "declared, not enforced yet — both of its children (`navigate`, `openIn`) carry the liveness verdict `planned`: no console consumer reads the block yet. No offer until it is enforced; whether to offer it then is a ruling for the enforcement, not for this gate". The key is now enforced. So this is no longer only text: whether the Studio action form should offer `onSuccess` is the ruling the entry defers.
  - `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` `authorWarnedTranslationGroups` docblock ("no shipped runner reads the group, so a translated wizard string really is stored and never shown"), and the matching header prose in `packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-liveness-gate.test.ts`. The gating these describe is unchanged. Only the reason given ("no shipped runner reads the group") is now half-true.
- The objectui main control `256b4c9e` is this container's objectui `origin/main` ref (a read-only checkout, not re-fetched). That checkout is shallow, so pin → main ancestry is not asserted.

## Changeset

`.changeset/20296-understated-planned-rows.md`, `@objectstack/spec: patch`, updated for the hint and prose corrections. `liveness/` and `src/**/*.zod.ts` are in `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]`, and `@objectstack/lint` reads the shipped ledgers at runtime, so this diff publishes. That is why this PR carries no `skip-changeset`.

## Deviations from the claim's file surface

- The amended surface is from seat comment 5860372033: the container `authorHint`, the README and the three comment sites. Two edits go beyond it, and both are text inside `translation.json`, which the claim already names:
  - a dated sentence appended to the `flows` container `note`, recording the flip and why the bit stays;
  - the `flows.screens` row's own closing sentence, which named the pre-ruling state.
- `undrilled-containers.baseline.json` is untouched, because the gate named no container row.
